blocks.source: assert rows_on(q, **{'orders': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(status AS STRING) AS status, CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM VALUES (1, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 100), (2, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 99.99) AS orders(order_id, customer_id, status, order_ts, amount)"}) == [(1, 1, '100.00')], 'boundary 100 included'

assert rows_on(q, **{'orders': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(status AS STRING) AS status, CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM VALUES (1, 1, 'placed', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 500) AS orders(order_id, customer_id, status, order_ts, amount)"}) == [], 'no paid orders'

assert rows_on(q, **{'orders': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(status AS STRING) AS status, CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM VALUES (1, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-07 23:59:59', 1), (2, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-08 00:00:00', 1), (3, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-05 00:00:00', 1), (4, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-04 23:59:59', 1) AS orders(order_id, customer_id, status, order_ts, amount)"}) == [(3, '2026-01-05 00:00:00'), (1, '2026-01-07 23:59:59')], 'late on the last day'

assert rows_on(q, **{'customers': "SELECT CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(name AS STRING) AS name, CAST(region AS STRING) AS region, CAST(signup_date AS DATE) AS signup_date FROM VALUES (1, 'RETAIL hub', 'N', DATE'2024-01-01'), (2, 'seafoods ltd', 'N', DATE'2024-01-01'), (3, 'Other', 'N', DATE'2024-01-01') AS customers(customer_id, name, region, signup_date)"}) == [('RETAIL hub',), ('seafoods ltd',)], 'mixed case'

assert rows_on(q, **{'products': "SELECT CAST(sku AS STRING) AS sku, CAST(category AS STRING) AS category, CAST(list_price AS DECIMAL(8,2)) AS list_price FROM VALUES ('SKU-40050', 'X', 1), ('XSKU-4005', 'X', 1), ('SKU-4005', 'X', 1), ('SKU-4010', 'X', 1) AS products(sku, category, list_price)"}) == [('SKU-4005', 'X')], 'anchored'

assert rows_on(q, **{'orders': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(status AS STRING) AS status, CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM VALUES (5, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 10), (3, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 10), (9, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 10), (1, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 10) AS orders(order_id, customer_id, status, order_ts, amount)"}) == [(1, '10.00'), (3, '10.00'), (5, '10.00')], 'ties broken by id'

assert rows_on(q, **{'orders': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(status AS STRING) AS status, CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM VALUES (1, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 50), (2, 1, 'shipped', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 150), (3, 1, 'placed', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 900) AS orders(order_id, customer_id, status, order_ts, amount)"}) == [(2, 'shipped', '150.00')], 'small paid excluded'

assert rows_on(q, **{'orders': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(status AS STRING) AS status, CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM VALUES (1, 1, 'returned', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 500), (2, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 150), (3, 2, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 201) AS orders(order_id, customer_id, status, order_ts, amount)"}) == [(2, 1, '201.00')], 'returned excluded'
